description: This file contains test cases for the SNProtocolOperator002 protocol implementation, written using Mocha and Chai testing frameworks. It tests cryptographic key generation, encryption/decryption, key parameter creation, and protocol operations related to version '002'.

classes.name: SNProtocolOperator002
classes.description: The class implementing protocol operations for version 002 used in encryption, decryption, and key management.

classes.name: SNWebCrypto
classes.description: The cryptographic utility class used for generating randomness and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: EncryptedPayload
classes.description: A class representing encrypted payload data, including content and associated cryptographic data.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Creates a root key for a given identifier and password based on protocol parameters.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Computes a root key from existing key parameters and password.

methods.name: encryptString002
methods.description: Encrypts a string using version 002 encryption scheme.

methods.name: decryptString002
methods.description: Decrypts a string encrypted with version 002 encryption scheme.

methods.name: generateEncryptedParametersAsync
methods.description: Generates encrypted parameters from a payload and items key.

methods.name: generateDecryptedParametersAsync
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted parameters back into payload content.
